rules: Refunds are available within 14 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–7 business days after approval.
Damaged-on-arrival items qualify for a full refund or replacement at the customer's choice.
Digital goods and gift cards are non-refundable once delivered.
allowed_promises: review the refund request within 2 business days
process an eligible refund to the original payment method within 5–7 business days
provide a prepaid return label for eligible returns
confirm when the refund has been approved
forbidden: instant cash refund
cash compensation or voucher beyond policy
guarantee a refund before eligibility is verified
refund amounts above the original purchase price
wire transfer or cryptocurrency payouts
refund.sla: Acknowledge within 24 hours; refund decision within 2 business days.

rules: Standard delivery is 3–5 business days; express is 1–2 business days where available.
Customers must be given the latest tracking status when a shipment is delayed.
Lost packages after the carrier's investigation window may be replaced or refunded.
Address changes are only possible before the package ships.
allowed_promises: share the latest tracking update
open a carrier investigation for delayed or missing packages
reship or refund if the package is confirmed lost
update the delivery estimate within 1 business day
forbidden: guarantee a same-day delivery date
promise courier contact numbers or personal driver details
offer free expedited shipping as compensation without approval
invent tracking numbers or delivery dates
delivery.sla: Tracking update within 1 business day; investigation opened within 2 business days for missing parcels.

rules: Duplicate charges are reversed after verification against the payment processor.
Subscription cancellations stop future renewals; the current billing period is not prorated unless stated.
Invoice copies can be resent to the account email on request.
allowed_promises: investigate the charge within 2 business days
reverse a verified duplicate charge
resend the invoice or receipt
confirm subscription cancellation for future renewals
forbidden: waive all future subscription fees indefinitely
promise chargeback outcomes with the bank
issue store credit larger than the disputed amount
share full card numbers or CVV
billing.sla: Billing investigation acknowledgment within 24 hours; resolution within 3 business days.

rules: Manufacturing defects within the warranty period qualify for repair, replacement, or refund.
Customers should provide order ID and a brief description or photo of the defect when available.
Misuse, accidental damage, and wear-and-tear are not covered.
allowed_promises: start a warranty review within 2 business days
arrange a replacement for a confirmed manufacturing defect
offer a refund if a covered defective item cannot be replaced
share return instructions for defective products
forbidden: admit legal liability or product recalls without authorization
promise medical or safety outcomes
offer lifetime free replacements
guarantee a specific repair turnaround of under 24 hours
product_defect.sla: Defect claim acknowledgment within 24 hours; warranty decision within 3 business days.

rules: Complaints about support interactions are logged and reviewed by a team lead.
Customers receive an apology and a clear next step without blaming the customer.
Callback requests are scheduled during business hours.
allowed_promises: escalate the experience feedback to a team lead
continue helping with the original issue
schedule a callback during business hours
document the complaint in the customer record
forbidden: discipline or fire a named employee
offer gift cards or cash for poor service without approval
promise a specific agent by name for all future contacts
service_quality.sla: Service complaint acknowledgment within 24 hours; lead review within 2 business days.

rules: Identity must be verified before account recovery steps are shared.
Suspicious logins can be temporarily frozen pending review.
Password reset links are sent only to the registered email address.
allowed_promises: send a password reset link to the registered email
temporarily freeze the account while investigating suspicious activity
guide the customer through identity verification
confirm when access has been restored
forbidden: ask for or accept passwords over email
bypass identity verification
share another customer's account details
promise that fraud losses will always be reimbursed
account_access.sla: Access issues acknowledged within 12 hours; unlock or clear next steps within 1 business day after verification.

rules: Answer only with information supported by this policy file.
If the question is outside policy, say a specialist will follow up.
Do not invent shipping regions, prices, or product specs.
allowed_promises: answer using published ShopEase policy information
point the customer to the relevant help article topic
have a specialist follow up within 2 business days if more detail is needed
forbidden: invent prices, stock levels, or shipping coverage
share internal contact lists or executive emails
make commitments for other departments without policy support
general_inquiry.sla: General inquiries answered within 1 business day.
